sources.entry: Spotify Play Count MCP - MCP server that gives AI assistants Spotify play counts for any track, album, artist or playlist, plus artist monthly listeners and followers; runs on your own Apify token. #opensource #mcp

summary.one_liner: An MCP server that lets AI assistants pull Spotify play counts for tracks, albums, artists and playlists, plus artist monthly listeners and followers, through a hosted Apify Actor.
use_cases: Check play counts for every track on an album or playlist
Compare monthly listeners and followers across artists
Find the most-played tracks on a playlist
Track an artist's streams per day over time
Give an AI assistant live Spotify stats without a Spotify login
how_to_run: claude mcp add --transport http spotify-play-count "<MCP endpoint URL>"
git clone <repository URL> && cd spotify-play-count-mcp && npm install
notable: Returns a play count for every track on a track, album, artist or playlist link in one call
Adds artist monthly listeners, followers, world rank and top cities
Optional streams over the last 1, 7 and 30 days for tracks in daily tracking
No Spotify login or proxy setup; runs on the user's own Apify token
Local stdio server and Python version both forward calls to the hosted endpoint
caveats: Daily stream fields are empty for a track's first day and fill in only after history builds up
Requires the user's own Apify API token or Apify OAuth to run tool calls
Built on public Spotify web pages and not affiliated with Spotify
The README's author states they maintain the Actor, which the hosted service depends on
